workItem.title: Quality evidence consistency between verify-stories and quality-check

requirements.statement: verify-stories and quality-check must derive requirement verdicts from one authoritative evidence source: executed coverage of current, non-superseded Story revisions in workflow state.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: After verify-stories with PASS scenarios for a requirement, quality-check for that requirement does not report missing independent evidence and does not return the item to Developer.
verify-stories records a requirement-scope verdict for every requirement it covered.
When all executed scenarios pass but the Story is unconfirmed, the requirement verdict is PASS_WITH_RISKS with reason story-unconfirmed:<storyId>@<revision>, distinct from missing evidence.
A FAIL scenario or a partial-success heuristic FAIL yields FAIL; neither tool upgrades PASS_WITH_RISKS to PASS without all scenarios PASS and every linked Story confirmed.
Coverage records the Story revision it verified; coverage from an older revision is not evidence for the current revision.
With no executed coverage, quality-check still reports missing independent evidence (green tests alone remain insufficient).
A regression test reproduces the original false finding and the corrected result through the Runtime workflow tools.

nextActions: Define the shared evidence function and coverage revision field

decisions.statement: Add requirementEvidence(state, requirementId) in praxis-core contracts/workflow.ts as the single evidence authority. It reads state.coverage for the requirement from non-superseded stories whose current revision equals the entry's storyRevision (entries without storyRevision are accepted for backward compatibility only while the story is at revision 1). Returns {status:'missing'} or {status:'executed', verdict (rollupStoryVerdict), reasons, provenance}. Unconfirmed linked stories add reason story-unconfirmed:<id>@<rev> and cap the verdict at PASS_WITH_RISKS. CoverageEntrySchema gains optional storyRevision, set by record-verification. record-verification records a requirement-scope verdict per covered requirement. quality-check: heuristic FAIL still wins; otherwise executed evidence decides the verdict; only status=missing produces the 'no independent behavioral evidence' finding; FAIL coverage produces a developer finding; unconfirmed-only risk produces no developer finding.

implementationUnits.summary: praxis-core 32aae64: requirementEvidence() shared by record-verification and quality-check; storyRevision on coverage; requirement verdict recorded by verify-stories; story-unconfirmed/story-not-verified reasons. Tests: contracts/src/quality-evidence.test.ts (7), negative control verified.

history.note: verify-stories executed checks and stored PASS coverage for REQ-CFG-001 (praxis-core WI-TREAT-UNEXPANDED-CLAUDE--001), yet quality-check reported 'no independent behavioral evidence' and returned the item to Developer. quality-check only applies an import partial-success heuristic and never reads state.coverage; verify-stories records no requirement-scope verdict, so feature-verdict always reports a missing requirement verdict.
